title: Fluffy Cheddar Biscuits
description: Golden, crisp, buttery cheddar biscuits that are light and fluffy inside with cheesy flavor throughout.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F and arrange racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, garlic powder, salt, and paprika.
Add the cubed cold butter and toss until coated in the flour mixture.
Use a pastry cutter or your hands to work the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs with no pieces larger than a pea.
If the butter becomes too soft, refrigerate the mixture for 15 minutes.
Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the shredded cheddar cheese.
In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the buttermilk and egg.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a wooden spoon until just combined.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions and place them on the prepared baking sheets, 6 biscuits per sheet.
Brush the tops with some of the melted butter and sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese over each biscuit.
Brush the biscuits with more melted butter, rotate the pans, and continue baking for 5 to 10 more minutes until golden brown.
Brush generously with the remaining melted butter and let cool for at least 10 minutes before serving.
